resources.string: Place the whole Filmroom recipe QR code in the viewfinder
Camera unavailable or permission denied. You can still choose a QR image.
Scan or choose a Filmroom recipe QR image. Everything is decoded offline. Review it before saving; your photo will not change.

Save a new recipe without overwriting existing recipes or changing your photo. Includes film, all editing settings, borders, composition, imprints, and custom dates. New settings missing from older codes use defaults. Apply it later from the recipe list.
Scan using Scan on Filmroom’s Recipes page.
Saved as a new recipe. Your photo is unchanged. Return to the recipe list to apply it.
No valid Filmroom recipe QR was found. Existing data is unchanged. Try a clear image showing the complete code.
This code contains a format, setting, or film this version does not support. Update Filmroom and retry. Nothing was imported or changed.
This recipe exceeds the supported single-QR capacity. No settings have been removed. Keep the original recipe; this version cannot share or import it as one code.
Could not share the QR image. Check available storage and try again.
